entries.title: Verizon eSIM Activation Steps
steps: Go to Settings > Cellular (or Mobile Data) on your device.
Tap 'Add Cellular Plan' or 'Add eSIM'.
Select 'Use QR Code' — scan the QR code from your Verizon confirmation email, or enter the activation code manually.
Follow on-screen prompts. When asked, choose 'Verizon' as your carrier plan.
Restart your device after activation completes.
If activation fails with error EE002: call *611 from another device — your account may need eSIM unlock enabled by an agent.

platform_responses.x: To activate your Verizon eSIM: Settings > Cellular > Add eSIM > scan QR from your confirmation email > restart. Error EE002? Call *611 — your account may need eSIM unlock. ^PG
platform_responses.reddit:
**Verizon eSIM Activation**

1. Settings > Cellular > Add Cellular Plan
2. Scan the QR code from your Verizon confirmation email (or enter the activation code manually)
3. Follow prompts, select Verizon plan, restart device

If you hit error **EE002** after restarting, your account needs eSIM unlock enabled — call *611 or visit a Verizon store. Usually resolved in under 10 minutes.
platform_responses.review: Thank you for reaching out. To activate your Verizon eSIM, go to Settings > Cellular > Add Cellular Plan and scan the QR code from your confirmation email. After completing the on-screen steps, restart your device. If you receive error EE002, please call *611 — your account may require eSIM unlock activation by our team. We apologize for the inconvenience.

entries.title: T-Mobile eSIM Activation Steps
steps: Open the T-Mobile app or go to t-mobile.com/activate.
On your device: Settings > Cellular > Add Cellular Plan.
Enter the activation code provided in your T-Mobile order confirmation.
Follow the prompts to complete setup. Choose 'T-Mobile' as your primary line if prompted.
Restart your device.
If you see 'SIM Not Supported': ensure your device is unlocked and compatible with T-Mobile eSIM (check t-mobile.com/esim-compatible-devices).

After restarting, your eSIM should be active. If you see 'SIM Not Supported,' please verify your device compatibility at t-mobile.com/esim-compatible-devices or contact our support team.

For device shipment tracking, use the UPS or FedEx tracking number emailed to you at the time of shipment.

entries.title: My Verizon App Troubleshooting
steps: Force-close the My Verizon app and reopen.
Check for app updates in the App Store or Google Play.
If the issue persists: Settings > Apps > My Verizon > Clear Cache (Android) or delete and reinstall (iOS).
Ensure your Verizon account credentials are current (try logging in at verizon.com).
Check verizonwireless.com/support for known app outages.
If the app shows 'Service Unavailable': this is typically a backend maintenance window (usually <2 hours).

entries.title: Verizon Bill Explanation
steps: View your itemised bill at verizon.com/mybill or My Verizon app > Billing > Bill Detail.
First bill is often higher than expected: includes partial month charges from activation date plus first full month.
Look for one-time charges: device payments, activation fees ($35), or equipment purchases.
Check for international roaming charges if you traveled — go to Account > Usage.
Premium services (Disney+, Apple One bundles) are listed separately under 'Third-Party Charges'.
Auto-pay discount ($10-20/line) may be missing if payment method was not set up — check Account > Auto Pay.
escalation_triggers: charge present that customer never authorised
auto-pay discount not applied for 2+ cycles

platform_responses.x: For Verizon bill details: verizon.com/mybill or My Verizon app > Billing > Bill Detail. First bills are often higher (partial month + first full month + any activation fees). Unexpected charge? Check Account > Usage for data/roaming. ^PG
platform_responses.reddit:
**Verizon bill higher than expected — common causes:**

1. **First bill**: Includes partial month (activation date to cycle end) + first full month
2. **Activation fee**: $35/line (one-time)
3. **Roaming**: Check Account > Usage if you travelled
4. **Missing auto-pay discount**: Check Account > Auto Pay — $10-20/line off if enrolled
5. **Third-party charges**: Premium add-ons listed separately

View full itemised bill at **verizon.com/mybill**. If you still see an unexplained charge, that needs a billing agent — call **\*611**.
platform_responses.review: We understand bill concerns can be stressful. Your itemised bill is available at verizon.com/mybill or in the My Verizon app under Billing > Bill Detail. First bills are commonly higher because they include a partial month plus a full month charge. If you see a charge you don't recognise, please call *611 and a billing specialist will review it.

entries.title: Verizon Individual Signal Troubleshooting
steps: Toggle Airplane Mode on for 30 seconds, then off — forces a fresh network registration.
Restart your device completely (not sleep/wake).
Check Verizon's coverage map at verizon.com/coverage — verify your area shows LTE/5G.
Settings > Cellular > Network Selection > set to Automatic (if on Manual).
Remove SIM, gently clean contacts, reinsert firmly.
Check for carrier settings update: Settings > General > About (iOS) — update if prompted.
If issue is location-specific: report the coverage gap at verizon.com/coverage/report.
Factory reset network settings (does not delete data): Settings > General > Transfer/Reset > Reset > Reset Network Settings.
escalation_triggers: signal issue started after account change

platform_responses.x: Verizon signal drops: try Airplane Mode toggle > full restart > check verizon.com/coverage for your area. Manual network selection? Switch to Automatic in Settings > Cellular. Persistent? Report gap at verizon.com/coverage/report ^PG
platform_responses.reddit:
**Verizon signal troubleshooting:**

1. Airplane Mode on 30s → off (forces re-registration)
2. Full device restart
3. Check **verizon.com/coverage** — confirm LTE/5G shows for your exact location
4. Settings > Cellular > Network Selection → Automatic
5. Remove and reseat SIM card
6. iOS: Settings > General > About — accept carrier settings update if prompted
7. Last resort: Reset Network Settings (Settings > General > Reset)

Persistent gap in a specific location? Report it at **verizon.com/coverage/report**.
platform_responses.review: We're sorry to hear about your signal issues. Please try toggling Airplane Mode on for 30 seconds then off, and perform a full device restart. You can also check your coverage at verizon.com/coverage. If the issue is location-specific, please report it at verizon.com/coverage/report and our network team will investigate.

entries.title: Verizon Device General Troubleshooting
steps: Perform a soft reset (full restart, not sleep/wake).
Check for pending software updates: Settings > General > Software Update (iOS) or Settings > System > System Update (Android).
Free up storage if device is >90% full — performance degrades significantly.
Check battery health: Settings > Battery > Battery Health (iOS). Below 80% causes throttling.
If a specific app is crashing: uninstall/reinstall, or check the app's own support page.
For Bluetooth/Wi-Fi issues: reset network settings.
Verizon warranty claims: verizon.com/repairs if device is within 1-year manufacturer warranty.
escalation_triggers: device purchased from Verizon less than 14 days ago

platform_responses.x: Device trouble on Verizon: full restart > check for OS updates > free up storage if >90% full. App crashing? Uninstall and reinstall. Warranty issue? verizon.com/repairs ^PG
platform_responses.reddit:

1. Full restart (not just sleep/wake)
2. Install pending OS updates: Settings > General > Software Update
3. Storage >90% full? Free up space — Android and iOS both throttle when storage is near capacity
4. iOS Battery Health <80%? Consider battery replacement (covered if within warranty)
5. App crashing: uninstall > reinstall
6. Wi-Fi/Bluetooth glitch: Reset Network Settings

Warranty claim (within 1 year): **verizon.com/repairs**
platform_responses.review: We're sorry you're having device trouble. Please start with a full device restart and check for OS updates. If storage is above 90% full, freeing space often resolves performance issues. For warranty repairs, please visit verizon.com/repairs.
